pull.author: paper-repo
pull.body:
Version 1 of the paper (merged into `main` from `candidate-primary`, PR #5, approved by the owners of the changed paths at cfe8a3c).

What it holds: the question (which k of N benchmarks to run, how to infer the rest, how large k must be); the protocol on MTEB (238 models, 328 tasks; held-out organisations, temporal and strength hold-outs; a common target set; margins and verdicts fixed in advance); the error-versus-k curve and k*(epsilon); designed selection against random selection and against the other selection and inference rules; the error decomposition (design term well predicted, floor 2.5 times the model's prediction, cause not identified); the synthetic and misspecification ladder; the scope sweeps; the checklist. Code, result files and reproduction notes are in `code/` and `results/`.

What it does not yet hold, and makes no statement about: the second matrix (Open LLM Leaderboard), adaptive against batch selection on synthetic data, the greedy-versus-exhaustive check and the fixed-rank sensitivity. These come with the result files and are for a later version.
